claim: The 4-class detector selectively identifies elephants in mixed-animal scenes.
constraint: Must be supported by frozen COCO metrics; do not generalize beyond evaluated image domains/classes.

claim: The 4-class detector is more selective than the original elephant-only detector.
constraint: Requires paired image-clustered CI on pre-locked metrics; do not claim if CI includes no improvement.

claim: The 4-class detector is robust to unseen animal species.
constraint: COCO confusers are OOD stress tests only; success does not establish universal unseen-species robustness.

claim: The 9-image elephant+lion supplement proves broad in-vocabulary robustness.
constraint: Supplement is small and lion-only; report as supplementary challenge evidence.

claim: Mixed-species image results validate detector-to-tracker-to-forecast end-to-end performance.
constraint: R17 image evaluation is detector/selective-filter robustness only; historical end-to-end limitation remains.
BAMBI remains cross-species/cross-domain negative stress only.

claim: Threshold 0.25 was chosen from test performance.
constraint: 0.25 is pre-locked before inference; test-dependent tuning is prohibited.
